authority.scope: Node.js-only local Task838 fixtures, tests and sanitized graph evidence

behavior: Seven installed DB/SQLite callers now use owned shared Node/Git/npm dispatch, private npm state and deferred offline installation after tarball admission.
Preserve all original installed assertions; use exact check-ignore exit 1 for commit-eligible paths rather than any nonzero status.
Explicit check-ignore path admission refuses options, escaping and linked paths; repository identity and index custody are preserved.
Pin core.excludesFile to os.devNull across fixture Git to prevent HOME/XDG and repository override ignore leakage; .gitignore and info/exclude remain effective.
Structured success follows artifact before/after checks and owned finalization; errors and cleanup failures remain visible.

legacy_git_redirect.method: Original caller function prefixes evaluated in a bounded synthetic harness; real Git index writes redirected to a separate owned sentinel, never canonical Git.

ambient_ignore.reproduction: ambient ignore masks missing project ignore rules

before.reason: check-ignore returned 0 instead of 1 without a project ignore rule

qualification.superseded: Initial 7-smoke/125-check passes per runtime predated the ambient-ignore correction and do not substitute for these final receipts.
limits: Three DB scenarios call installed-package internal helper exports; they are not exclusively public CLI exercises and not canonical source imports.
Synchronous internal helper calls have outer smoke timeout supervision, not individual per-call subprocess deadlines.
Node-only trusted fixture process supervision is not an adversarial OS sandbox.
Current runs are intermediate caller qualification, not full suite, coverage, release ladder, final artifact, Linux or Windows qualification.

review.mode: one bounded independent read-only review and narrow correction follow-up
review.finding: Ambient core.excludesFile defaults/overrides leaked into admitted check-ignore.
review.disposition: Parent reproduced; fixed with forced empty external excludes; focused and installed checks passed. Correction source review found no remaining concrete gap in its limited scope.
